title: The Fallen Watchtower
text: A watchtower fallen in some old storm, its good dressed stone scattered down the hill like spilled dice. The beacon basket lies crushed in the grass. Someone kept watch here once. Whatever they were watching for, it came.

options.label: Haul the good stone away. The tower will not stand again.

outcomes.text: Heavy, good stone, and somewhere under the last of it, a skeleton still facing the road, still watching.

options.label: The sharpest eye searches the ruin, for what the guard left behind.

outcomes.text: The guard's strongbox, under the beacon basket, still locked.

options.label: Mark it for the House to rebuild, so that someone watches once again.

outcomes.text: A watchtower of your own, in time, to watch for whatever came. You hope it does not come again.
